declarations.name: configureMath
declarations.description: Sets page-wide defaults for every `c2-math`; elements already rendered pick them up on their next render.

A TeX formula rendered as native MathML by [Temml](https://temml.org): the browser lays it out with the system math
font and exposes it to assistive technology, so there is no font CSS and no HTML layout to ship. Write the TeX in the
`value` attribute or as the element's text (a `<script type="math/tex">` child keeps the browser from parsing it);
`display` renders a centred block formula instead of an inline one.

Untrusted input is safe: links, images, classes, ids and styles from TeX (`\href`, `\includegraphics`, `\class`, …)
are rejected, expansion and sizes are capped, and the output is built as DOM nodes, never parsed from a string. A
formula that does not parse shows its source in the error style and fires `math-error`. Copying a whole formula
puts its TeX on the clipboard as text and its MathML as HTML. On the server the TeX source renders as code until
the element upgrades.

cssProperties.default: Cambria Math, STIX Two Math, STIXTwoMath-Regular, NotoSansMath-Regular, math

cssProperties.description: Math fonts run small next to body text.
cssProperties.name: --c2-math--font-size

cssProperties.description: Focus ring of a display formula that overflows and scrolls.

members.name: value
members.description: TeX source. When unset, the element's text content is used.

members.name: display
members.description: Block (display) style, centred on its own line. Inline when false.

members.name: macros
members.description: Macros for this formula, e.g. `{ '\\RR': '\\mathbb{R}' }`. Page-wide ones come from `configureMath`.

members.name: hydrating
members.description: Upgraded over a server-rendered shadow root: the first render must repeat the server's template to hydrate.

members.name: mathml
members.description: The rendered MathML as markup, or an empty string when the source did not parse.

members.name: handleCopy
members.description: A selection inside one formula copies its TeX as text and its MathML as HTML.

events.name: math-error
events.description: The source failed to parse. `position` is the offset of the problem when known.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: TeX source. When unset, the element's text content is used.
